sources.title: 国土数値情報（鉄道データ）2025年度版 N02-25
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0); the MLIT page also states open data conditions for 2020 onward.
sources.coordinateTransformation: None. Source JGD2011 geographic coordinates are preserved without datum or projection transformation.
sources.sourceGeometryDescription: Generalized route/station line features; not individual surveyed physical track centerlines.
sources.sourceCoordinateQualityNote: MLIT product-page quality rate is a comparison against referenced source data and is not a stated ground-survey metre error bound.

name.value: 近鉄京都線 京都—大和西大寺
name.note: Route name, operator, and selected station names are present in the N02-25 route/station records.

railwayClass.note: N02-25 railway-class attribute N02_001; code 12 is ordinary railway per the official code list.

route.description: The route line is preserved from MLIT N02-25 and joined by exact shared endpoints. Only direction, local chainage, station ordering measures, and package IDs are derived. This is a generalized map-scale reference line; it is not a measured individual rail or a driving route.

routeReferenceLineLengthM.note: Cumulative GRS80 ellipsoidal inverse-geodesic distance between published route-line vertices, rounded to 0.001 m. This is not track survey length or operator mileage; absolute position/generalization error is not quantified.

officialRailwayChainageM.note: No official station chainage or operational kilometer-post data is included in the selected source.

physicalTrackLengthM.note: The generalized route reference line is not measured rail length.

name.note: Published N02-25 station-name attribute; this does not identify a particular platform, stop point, or station center.

stationCode.note: Published N02-25 station code. It is a dataset key, not a railway operator station code.

routeOrderReferencePositionM.note: Median of the nearest route-vertex chainages for the vertices of the published station LineString. It is an ordering aid only, not a station-center position, official chainage, or stop marker.

stationLineRouteMeasureRangeM.note: Range of route-reference measures nearest to the published station-line vertices; not platform endpoints or station limits.

physicalTrackCenterline.note: Physical individual track centerline is not supplied by N02 route reference geometry.

trackCountAndAlignment.note: Number and alignment of individual running tracks are not established by this package.

trackGaugeMM.note: Track gauge is not part of the selected N02 source attributes.

curveRadiusM.note: Curve radii and transition curves are not supplied.

cantMM.note: Cant and cant run-off are not supplied.

gradientPermille.note: Longitudinal gradients and vertical curves are not supplied.

elevationM.note: Rail elevation is not supplied by the selected source features.

speedRestrictions.note: Route-, direction-, vehicle-, and time-specific speed restrictions are not supplied.

signalsAndBlocks.note: Signals, interlocking, block boundaries, and aspects are not supplied.

protectionSystems.note: ATS/ATC and wayside protection equipment are not supplied.

platformsAndStopPoints.note: Platform geometry, platform lengths, and stopping points are not supplied; station lines are not platforms.

switchesAndYards.note: Turnouts, crossovers, yards, and station track layout are not supplied.

bridgesTunnelsCrossings.note: Structure identities and exact chainage are not supplied in the selected extraction.

timetable.note: Timetables and operating plans are not supplied.

route.provenanceNote: The route line is preserved from MLIT N02-25 and joined by exact shared endpoints. Only direction, local chainage, station ordering measures, and package IDs are derived. This is a generalized map-scale reference line; it is not a measured individual rail or a driving route.

processing.routeSelection: Filtered N02-25_RailroadSection and N02-25_Station by operator='近畿日本鉄道', route='京都線'; traversed the resulting one-component, unbranched, open endpoint chain from the endpoint matching 京都 to the endpoint matching 大和西大寺.
processing.routeOrientation: Source route segments were reversed only when needed to form a continuous Kyoto-to-Yamato-Saidaiji chain; coordinates themselves were not transformed.
processing.chainageComputation: GRS80 ellipsoid inverse-geodesic between each consecutive published source vertex. Unit: metre. Values are local route-reference measures, not official railway chainage.
processing.stationOrdering: Stations sorted by the median of nearest route-vertex measures for each source station-line vertex. The derived measure is only an ordering aid; source station LineStrings are retained and not converted to center points or platforms.
processing.provenance: Original N02 attributes and source record indices are included in each extracted feature. New IDs are package identifiers, not MLIT feature IDs.

packageLocalIdentifier.note: The packageID and routeID are local identifiers created for this separate research package; they are not MLIT or operator route identifiers.

routeNameOperatorAndClass.note: Values are copied from the selected N02-25 route feature attributes.

stationNamesAndDatasetCodes.note: Names and dataset codes are copied from N02-25 station feature attributes; codes are not operator station identifiers.

extractedFeatureAndVertexCounts.note: Counts are exact counts of the route/station features and route vertices selected from the pinned source archive; they are not railway engineering measurements.

sourceRecordIndices.note: Zero-based feature positions in the pinned N02-25 GeoJSON collections, retained for provenance and reproducibility.

routeCoordinates.note: Coordinates preserve N02-25 source vertices in JGD2011/(B,L); low confidence describes their use as physical track alignment because the source line is generalized and no ground-survey error bound is given.

stationLineGeometry.note: Original source station LineStrings are preserved; they are not station-center points, platform shapes, or stop markers.

segmentOrientationAndContinuity.note: The source line segments are ordered/oriented using shared endpoints to make a Kyoto-to-Yamato-Saidaiji reference chain.

localVertexChainageAndReferenceLength.note: Derived from GRS80 inverse-geodesic distances between published vertices; not official railway chainage or measured track length.

stationOrderReferenceMeasure.note: Median nearest-route-vertex measure of the source station-line vertices; used only to order stations, not as station-center chainage.

operationalAndTrackEngineeringFields.note: Physical track, operations, platforms, signals, restrictions, structures, and timetable values are absent from this extraction and must not be inferred.
